1:
Edit this exact 2048x2048 4 by 4 grid template. Paint EXACTLY 16 independent educational vocabulary illustrations, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. KEEP the five vertical and five horizontal continuous PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines including the entire outer border, in their exact positions and thickness. Do not cover or move the lines. Magenta is reserved for the grid. No captions, letters, written text, numbers, labels, speech text, logos or watermarks. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with simple backgrounds, correct human anatomy, large legible subjects. All artwork remains entirely inside its own cell. Use cell space generously. For actions make who does what unambiguous, using small motion arrows or a before/after pair WITHIN the same cell when useful. For abstract qualities show a specific understandable example. A slash separates words sharing that SAME depicted action, not separate illustrations; show the common concrete scene for all meanings. Each cell must have a different picture. Exact row-major subjects:
1. Three children arrive one after another at the same classroom door, three positions connected by arrows to show repeated successive arrivals, NOT changing seasons.
2. A child writes with a much-used favorite wooden pencil beside its familiar worn pencil case, clearly loving and repeatedly using this tool.
3. A room flooded with daylight through a large window, bright and well lit.
4. A child who has stopped trying to ride a bicycle, sitting beside the bike looking resigned, another attempt abandoned.
5. A child astonished and exasperated looking at a cake that has toppled over.
6. An energetic child enthusiastically running outdoors.
7. A child looking admiringly at an older soccer player, wishing to play that well; NO jersey numbers.
8. A child standing in ankle-deep clear river water, visible bottom close to the surface, shallow water.
9. ONE within-cell paired scene: child hands a book to a librarian who safely keeps it for the child. Librarian and child wear green and yellow. Book yellow. No pink or magenta artwork.
10. A mother directly gives a blue gift box to a delighted child.
11. Ordinary everyday scene: morning sun rising over houses, the usual natural daily event, sunrise NOT a supernatural scene.
12. A cook skillfully handling a frying pan, clearly operating a tool.
13. A hand puts a puzzle piece into its matching opening, piece and opening shapes match exactly.
14. A young performer on stage reacting spontaneously to dropping a juggling ball, turning the unexpected mistake into a funny friendly bow; pair inside ONE cell.
15. An analog clock showing time with hands and tick marks, no numerals or letters.
16. Water overflowing the rim of a full glass onto a table.
Keep all artwork strictly free of pink, violet, purple and magenta shades. Magenta ONLY in grid lines.
